name: Card
summary: A surface that groups related content — cover, title, body and footer actions — in default/small size, bordered or flat, with a hover lift and a loading skeleton.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-card> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Card is a family, not a single box: slot="cover" adds a full-bleed image, `card-title` renders the header with slot="extra" for a right-aligned action, the default slot is the body, slot="actions" is a ruled-off footer row. `size` (default · small) tunes the padding, `bordered="false"` drops the outline, `hoverable` lifts the card on hover, and `loading` swaps the body for a shimmer skeleton. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens — zero drift, the same element in every framework.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Cover
spec.value: full-bleed media above the header, no inset; hidden when the slot is empty

spec.label: Header
spec.value: padding 16/20 · 16/24 SemiBold #1A1A1A · divider #F1F1F1 · extra action right-aligned

spec.label: Actions
spec.value: footer row, 12/20 padding, 8 gap, top divider #F1F1F1; hidden when empty

spec.label: Hover (hoverable)
spec.value: border #D3B4FF + shadow, motion-mid ease-out on a persistent node

spec.label: Loading
spec.value: body → shimmer skeleton bars (aria-busy), motion-slow sweep

props.name: card-title
props.desc: Renders the header row; omit for a bare body

props.name: bordered
props.desc: Set bordered="false" for a flat, outline-less surface

props.name: hoverable
props.desc: Lift the card (border + shadow) on hover

props.name: loading
props.desc: Swap the body for a shimmer skeleton while content loads

props.name: extra
props.desc: Right-aligned header action (a link or button)

whenToUse.when: grouping related content into a titled surface on a dashboard or settings page
many uniform rows of the same shape
read-only label/value pairs about one entity

opinion.note: Titles are sentence case and name the group — 'Live results', not 'LIVE RESULTS'. Keep one idea per card; reach for hoverable only when the whole card is clickable. Use a cover for a media-led card, footer actions for card-level operations, and loading while the body fetches.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Card component-set taxonomy (Card + Card_Image_Wrapper for the cover, Card_Meta_Wrapper for the title/body meta, plus size/bordered/hoverable states matching antd Card). DS V3's measured set has no Card cell, so px/rgb are derived from the token layer (radius-lg, border, border-hover, split, bg-container, text-default/secondary, ink-a10) + antd Card conventions (16/24 header + 20 body default; 8/12 header + 12 body small). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: cover full-bleed above header; footer actions ruled off (hidden when empty)
hover lifts via motion tokens (persistent node)
small size tightens header/body padding; bordered=false flattens outline
loading swaps body for shimmer skeleton (aria-busy)
